description: This Java class defines the ServiceEcaRule, which models rules for service event-condition-action logic within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes parsing XML configuration, evaluating conditions, and executing actions based on service events.

classes.name: ServiceEcaRule
classes.description: Represents a rule for service event-condition-action processing, including condition evaluation and action execution.

methods.name: getShortDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a short string combining service name and event name.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service associated with this rule.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the event name associated with this rule.

methods.name: getDefinitionLocation
methods.description: Returns the location where this rule is defined.

methods.name: getEcaActionList
methods.description: Returns a list of actions to execute when conditions are met.

methods.name: getEcaConditionList
methods.description: Returns a list of conditions for this rule.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates conditions and executes actions if conditions are true, considering error and failure states.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if this rule is enabled.
